_what: The one home of dataset, coder and output paths for laboratory runs (../CLAUDE.md R08). Runs read paths here; command-line arguments override.
_how: Copy this file to lab_paths.json beside it and edit the paths. That copy is ignored by git: it holds YOUR machine's layout. Relative paths are resolved against the repository root, so ../Images means a sibling of core/.

coders._note: Path to each external coder executable; the version is recorded by the wrapper, not here.
